description: Source code for Kubernetes NodeAuthorizer, implementing request authorization logic for kubelet requests, including resource-specific rules, path validation, and node identity checks.

classes.name: NodeAuthorizer
classes.description: Implements authorization logic for kubelet requests, including resource-specific rules, node identity validation, and path-based relationship checks.

methods.name: NewAuthorizer
methods.description: Constructs a new NodeAuthorizer with provided graph, node identifier, and rules.

methods.name: RulesFor
methods.description: Returns resource and non-resource rules for a user; indicates if user is a node.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Main authorization method that checks if a request from a node is permitted based on resource, subresource, verb, and path relationships.

methods.name: authorizeStatusUpdate
methods.description: Authorizes update/patch requests to status subresources related to a node.

methods.name: authorizeGet
methods.description: Authorizes 'get' requests for resources related to a node.

methods.name: authorizeReadNamespacedObject
methods.description: Authorizes 'get', 'list', 'watch' requests for namespaced objects related to a node.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Checks if a path exists from a resource to a node, allowing or denying access.

methods.name: authorizeServiceAccount
methods.description: Authorizes access to service accounts, including token creation.

methods.name: authorizeCreateToken
methods.description: Authorizes creation of tokens for service accounts on a node.

methods.name: authorizeLease
methods.description: Authorizes node requests to node lease resources.

methods.name: authorizeCSINode
methods.description: Authorizes node requests to CSINode objects.

methods.name: authorizeResourceSlice
methods.description: Authorizes node requests to ResourceSlice resources.

methods.name: authorizePodCertificateRequest
methods.description: Authorizes pod certificate request operations related to a node.

methods.name: authorizeNode
methods.description: Authorizes node API object operations, including get, create, update, patch.

methods.name: authorizePod
methods.description: Authorizes pod-related requests, including get, list, watch, create, delete, and status updates.

methods.name: hasPathFrom
methods.description: Checks if a relationship path exists from a resource to a node via the graph.
